Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` is now classified as "Mock resources" (test code), at any depth and with either path separator. The full `codeanalyzer` suite passes offline: 338 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped.

**What changed**
- `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`: I replaced the two mock folder regexes with one, `(.*[/\\])?(__)?mock[^/\\]*[/\\].*`. The folder-name part `[^/\\]*` accepts any characters, including punctuation and non-ASCII, and the match stays within a single folder name. Bare `mock/` also matches now.
- `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsMockTest.java` (new): checks the elasticsearch `mock/` case, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe`, `mock模拟`, backslash paths, and every folder that was test before. It also checks that `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` stay out.

Nothing is committed.
